transcript.content: Hello, it's nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

I guess… I’ve been feeling like everything that goes wrong is my fault. Like I’m just failing at work, and at home too. It’s hard to shake the feeling that I kind of deserve to lose the things I worked for.
Did these feelings start after a specific stressful event or major change in your life?
Yeah… I think it started after I bought my townhouse. The pressure of keeping up with it just kind of built up. It’s been… a little over two years, maybe two years and three months.
Have you been feeling this way most days for at least two weeks in a row?
Yeah… definitely more than two weeks. It’s been like this most days for… about two years or so. Maybe two years and a month.
Do these feelings seem mainly connected to the stress of owning and keeping up with the townhouse?
Mostly, yeah. It kind of started after I bought the townhouse… and then the pressure of keeping up with it just kept building. It’s been about two years and three months now.
If the stress about the townhouse eased up, do you think these feelings would mostly go away?

I don’t know if it would fully go away. Maybe some of it would ease up, but… I still keep feeling like everything that goes wrong is my fault. Like I’m just failing at being an employee and a homeowner.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah… I guess I have. I used to plan brunches, paint in the spare room, go hiking, things like that. Even networking events. Now it all just feels like… something I’m supposed to care about, but I don’t really.
Before this started after buying the townhouse, had you ever gone through another period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed or lost interest in things most days?
I’m not really sure. I mean… I’ve had rough stretches before, but I don’t know if it was like two weeks most days or anything I kept track of.
Do these feelings seem stronger than you’d expect just from the stress of owning the townhouse?

Yeah… probably. I mean, the townhouse is stressful, but this feels bigger than that. I keep feeling like every little thing that goes wrong is my fault… like I’m just bad at all of it and deserve to lose what I worked for.
Have you had thoughts that you would be better off dead or of hurting yourself?
I… I don’t really know how to answer that. I don’t think I’ve made any plan or anything. Sometimes I just feel really tired of dealing with everything, but… I don’t know.
Have you had thoughts that you would be better off dead?
I’m… not sure. I don’t think I’d say it that clearly. It’s more like… I get really worn down and don’t want to deal with anything, but I don’t know.
Before this began after buying the townhouse, was there ever a time in your life when you felt depressed or lost interest in things nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I’m not really sure. I’ve had rough periods before, I guess, but I don’t know if it was nearly every day for two weeks like that. I didn’t really keep track.
Before you bought the townhouse, was there ever a time when you felt depressed or lost interest in things nearly every day for two weeks or more?
I don’t really know. Before the townhouse… I mean, I had times I felt down, but I can’t say if it was nearly every day or lasted that long. I just didn’t think about it that way.
Do you spend a lot of time worrying and find it hard to stop the worry?
I don’t know… I mean, I worry some, but I’m not sure if it’s a lot or if it’s hard to stop. I haven’t really paid attention to it like that.
Do you ever find yourself thinking that you would be better off dead?
I… I don’t really know. I don’t think about it in those exact words, I guess. It’s kind of hard to answer.
Have you wished you were dead?
I’m not sure… I don’t really know how to answer that. Maybe sometimes I feel like I don’t want to deal with things, but I don’t know if that’s the same.
Are you thinking about killing yourself?
I… I don’t know. I don’t think I’m, like, planning anything. It’s hard to say more than that.
Have you been sleeping more or less than usual?
Less, I think. I’m not sleeping much… most nights I just lie there for hours, and then I wake up around three or four and can’t really get back to sleep before work.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or low on energy?
I don’t know… maybe a little. I haven’t really been paying attention to it.
Have these feelings been making it hard for you to function at work or take care of things at home?

Yeah… a bit. I’m still going to work, but it’s been harder to keep up. I’ve made some mistakes, enough that my supervisor’s been checking in more. And at home, I’ve kind of let things pile up… the townhouse is messier than I like. I’ve also been canceling plans. It just takes a lot more effort than it should.
Do you often feel worthless?

Yeah… I guess I do. I keep feeling like everything that goes wrong is because of me. Like I’m just… failing at work, failing at home. Sometimes it feels like I deserve to lose the things I worked for.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient reports a sustained depressive syndrome with depressed mood/self-blame, marked loss of interest, insomnia, worthlessness/excessive guilt, and clear functional impairment lasting well beyond two weeks. Although symptoms began after a psychosocial stressor (buying a townhouse), the patient states the syndrome feels stronger than expected from that stressor and would not fully remit if the stress eased, favoring a depressive episode over adjustment disorder. Prior distinct depressive episodes were not established, so recurrent depressive disorder is not confirmed. Anxiety symptoms were not sufficiently characterized to support an anxiety disorder as the primary diagnosis.
